reason: One sequential ordinary-load window with deterministic interleaving, uncontrolled activity, common caches and startup state cannot establish exchangeability. 60 observations alone do not authorize 95/95 inference.

U.rule: If all planned 60 Case-C samples have qualifying uncensored semantic/exit/console completion, report the maximum whole-lifecycle completion as U_observed for this finite campaign only. Otherwise report the observed qualifying maximum descriptively and leave selection U NOT_ESTABLISHED.
U.scope: No population coverage, future-load guarantee, zero-timeout probability, worst-case Windows bound or mathematical maximum.

V.rule: For the finite observed envelope V_observed=0 because its observed ordinary-load/startup variability is already in its maximum. Future variability beyond this single window is not numerically bounded and must remain explicit; do not manufacture a reserve or double-count the range.

Q.rule: Measure monotonic call/timer granularity, IPC/control and snapshot calibration outside the helper clock; retain actual event-order differences and exact native handle identities. Measure private-sequence transfer separately without double-counting transport decode. These finite observations do not automatically upper-bound future measurement/transfer cost.
Q.unknownRule: Unbounded residual uncertainty remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. Upward rounding can absorb it only if a defensible numerical upper bound proves it fits the rounding remainder. Unknown uncertainty cannot be absorbed by assertion.

R.gate: A finite observed U is not alone a transferable replacement-bound claim. Every required transfer/residual variability term must be defensibly bounded; otherwise R remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

comparison: Retained product campaigns are separate corroboration, never pooled or used as successful observations when censored. Controls detect broad slowdown but do not derive Case-C U.
